Melt-in-the-mouth bhallas, sweet and spicy chutneys, creamy sweetened dahi, crunchy papdi, and my special chaat masala. A complete chaat lover’s dream, and I’ve shared all the tips you need to get the softest, fluffiest bhallas at home!
I’ve also shown you how to assemble the most incredible Dahi Bhalla Papdi Chaat, just the way we all love it. The chutney links are mentioned below, along with the full written recipes for the bhallas, sweet dahi, and my special chaat masala. Do give this one a try. Happy Cooking!
